items.exampleEn: Here are some recent photos of my family.
items.exampleZh: 這是我家人最近的幾張照片。

items.exampleEn: My office is on the third floor.
Many things changed in the last century.
items.exampleZh: 上個世紀發生了很多變化。

items.exampleEn: I recently started a new job.
items.exampleZh: 我最近開始了一份新工作。

items.exampleEn: I didn't understand the beginning of the movie.
items.exampleZh: 我看不懂那部電影的開頭。

items.exampleEn: Regular exercise is good for you.

items.sentenceEn: I have been very busy recently.

items.audioEn: The meeting room is on the third floor, next to the kitchen.
items.audioZh: 會議室在三樓，就在茶水間旁邊。

items.sentenceEn: At the beginning, the work was hard.
items.sentenceZh: 一開始，這份工作很辛苦。

items.sentenceEn: Tomorrow is the final day of our trip.
items.sentenceZh: 明天是我們這趟旅行的最後一天。

items.stemEn: This bridge was built in 1930, so it is almost a ____ old.
items.stemZh: 這座橋建於 1930 年，所以已經快一百年了。

items.stemEn: Have you seen any good movies ____?
items.stemZh: 你最近有看什麼好電影嗎？

items.passageEn: My grandparents' house is almost a century old. At the beginning, it was just a small house on a farm. My grandfather was the third child in his family, and he has lived there all his life. Recently, my parents painted the whole house for him. We pay them regular visits, and I always enjoy seeing them.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺奶奶的房子快一百年了。一開始，它只是農場上的一間小房子。爺爺是家裡的第三個孩子，他一輩子都住在那裡。最近，我爸媽幫他把整棟房子重新油漆了一遍。我們定期去探望他們，每次見到他們我都很開心。

questions.questionZh: 爺爺是家裡的第幾個孩子？

options: 爺爺把老房子賣給別人
爺爺搬到城市的公寓住

items.promptZh: 這是我最近拍的一張照片。
referenceEn: This is a recent photo that I took.
This is a photo I took recently.
rubricZh: recent 放在名詞前（例如 a recent photo）；寫 a photo I took recently 也正確
「拍照」可寫例如 took、took a photo

items.instructionZh: 用 regular 造一個句子，說說你規律在做的一件事。
referenceEn: I go to bed at a regular time every night.
I do regular exercise in the park.
rubricZh: regular 表示「規律的、定期的」，可放在名詞前（例如 regular exercise）或 be 動詞後
說平常的習慣用現在式（例如 go、do）
句子說的是自己的事，主詞是 I
